script_text: AQUARIUS — Uranus, your ruling planet, is triggering a cosmic earthquake in your life this week that you never saw coming. Early week, Mercury forms a tense square with Saturn in your 4th House through Monday and Tuesday, bringing family tension and communication breakdowns at home — avoid heavy conversations until Wednesday. Then on Wednesday, the Sun sextiles Jupiter in your 9th House, and suddenly doors open for travel, new ideas, and financial breakthroughs. By Thursday, Venus glides into your 5th House of love and romance, and Aquarius, someone unexpected is about to catch your eye — a spark you cannot ignore. The weekend brings Neptune trine your 12th House on Saturday and Sunday, urging rest and spiritual reflection — your Air element needs grounding now. Monday is your worst day because Mercury-Saturn square clouds every exchange. Wednesday is your power day because Jupiter's sextile illuminates career expansion and financial fortune. Dress in green before every important meeting this week — it channels abundance. Follow for daily cosmic updates.
